title: Appearance
description: The interface colours, and those of the manufacturer of the ship you fly.

mode.title: Theme
mode.shipHint: In the pilot seat, the interface takes the colours of the ship's manufacturer, from the game's telemetry. Elsewhere, the theme chosen below.
mode.telemetryHint: The automatic switch needs the game's telemetry (Settings › Game). Without it, the chosen theme applies everywhere.

options.title: Options
options.keepLastShip: Keep the last ship's theme after leaving it
options.keepLastShipHint: Otherwise, the interface goes back to the chosen theme ten seconds after leaving the seat.
options.anySeat: Switch at turrets and crew stations too
options.anySeatHint: By default, only the pilot seat changes the theme.
options.announceHint: A notification names the manufacturer, with a button to keep the usual theme in this ship.
options.effectsHint: The backdrop pattern, the glows and the brackets on card corners. The colours stay.
